Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequests->any(lr: LoanRequest|lr.RequestID = id),
		approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter = self.CurrentApprovalLetter
	precondition:
		self.CurrentLoanRequests->exists(lr: LoanRequest|lr.RequestID = id)
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and
		approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		approvalLetter.Content = 'standard content' and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and
		result = true
}
